goal: As Tomasz Wierzbicki, create a draft resource estimate for PRJ-0409 Kettle Lake: ordinary kriging, cut-off 0.3 % Ni, Indicated 4.2 Mt at 1.35 % Ni and Inferred 6.8 Mt at 1.10 % Ni.
diagnosis: The run went wrong on the Resources landing page: the agent used the Projects section link, which returned to the project register, instead of the Estimates link that leads to the estimate register and new-estimate action. The atlas described All estimates only as a list of existing records, so it did not signal that estimate creation starts there.

lessons.what: Opens the estimates register, where New estimate starts a draft for a project.
lessons.not_for: Project records; the nearby Projects link opens the project register.
lessons.why: This was the route to the creation control from the Resources landing page.

lessons.what: Opens the Projects register and project records.
lessons.not_for: Resource estimates; they live in Resources under All estimates.
lessons.why: The agent confused the Projects section link with the path to create an estimate.
